Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a new 4-column by 5-row sprite atlas (20 separate sprites) of the SAME chitin skitter from the reference, with a fixed elevated 3/4 game camera. Reference is identity/style only. Rows in order: SOUTH(front face toward viewer), SOUTHEAST(front-right 3/4), EAST(right profile), NORTHEAST(rear-right 3/4, face hidden), NORTH(direct back, no face). These are anatomical turns, NOT rotation of a flat image. Each row has 4 genuinely different alternating leg phases of walking. Stable body proportions and pixel style: slate chitin, ivory spikes, front amber eyes, six legs. EXACTLY 4 equal columns and 5 equal rows. ENTIRE body including legs/spikes must occupy only 60% of each cell width and height; 20% clear transparent padding around each. Same feet baseline at 80% cell height, same scale across all frames. Transparent RGBA, no shadows, no backdrop, no glow, no grid lines, no text, no labels.
